auth_tokens_terminal_state_check.name: auth_tokens_terminal_state_check
auth_tokens_terminal_state_check.value: not ("auth_tokens"."consumed_at" is not null and "auth_tokens"."invalidated_at" is not null)

custom_fields_project_key_unique.name: custom_fields_project_key_unique
custom_fields_project_key_unique.where: "custom_fields"."project_id" is not null and "custom_fields"."deleted_at" is null

idempotency_keys_state_check.name: idempotency_keys_state_check
idempotency_keys_state_check.value: ("idempotency_keys"."status" = 'completed' and "idempotency_keys"."completed_at" is not null and "idempotency_keys"."response_status_code" is not null) or ("idempotency_keys"."status" <> 'completed' and "idempotency_keys"."completed_at" is null and "idempotency_keys"."response_status_code" is null and "idempotency_keys"."response_body" is null)

integration_credentials_revocation_check.name: integration_credentials_revocation_check
integration_credentials_revocation_check.value: ("integration_credentials"."status" = 'revoked' and "integration_credentials"."revoked_at" is not null) or ("integration_credentials"."status" <> 'revoked' and "integration_credentials"."revoked_at" is null)

membership_permission_overrides_scope_ch.name: membership_permission_overrides_scope_check
membership_permission_overrides_scope_ch.value:
("membership_permission_overrides"."scope" = 'organization' and "membership_permission_overrides"."workspace_id" is null and "membership_permission_overrides"."project_id" is null)
        or ("membership_permission_overrides"."scope" = 'workspace' and "membership_permission_overrides"."workspace_id" is not null and "membership_permission_overrides"."project_id" is null)
        or ("membership_permission_overrides"."scope" = 'project' and "membership_permission_overrides"."workspace_id" is not null and "membership_permission_overrides"."project_id" is not null)

membership_role_bindings_scope_check.name: membership_role_bindings_scope_check
membership_role_bindings_scope_check.value:
("membership_role_bindings"."scope" = 'organization' and "membership_role_bindings"."workspace_id" is null and "membership_role_bindings"."project_id" is null)
        or ("membership_role_bindings"."scope" = 'workspace' and "membership_role_bindings"."workspace_id" is not null and "membership_role_bindings"."project_id" is null)
        or ("membership_role_bindings"."scope" = 'project' and "membership_role_bindings"."workspace_id" is not null and "membership_role_bindings"."project_id" is not null)

refresh_tokens_replacement_check.name: refresh_tokens_replacement_check
refresh_tokens_replacement_check.value: ("refresh_tokens"."replaced_by_token_id" is null) or ("refresh_tokens"."used_at" is not null and "refresh_tokens"."replaced_by_token_id" <> "refresh_tokens"."id")

refresh_tokens_revocation_check.name: refresh_tokens_revocation_check
refresh_tokens_revocation_check.value: ("refresh_tokens"."revoked_at" is null and "refresh_tokens"."revoke_reason" is null) or ("refresh_tokens"."revoked_at" is not null and "refresh_tokens"."revoke_reason" is not null)

roles_organization_key_unique.name: roles_organization_key_unique
roles_organization_key_unique.where: "roles"."organization_id" is not null and "roles"."deleted_at" is null

roles_ownership_check.name: roles_ownership_check
roles_ownership_check.value: ("roles"."is_system" and "roles"."organization_id" is null) or (not "roles"."is_system" and "roles"."organization_id" is not null)

security_events_identity_check.name: security_events_identity_check
security_events_identity_check.value: "security_events"."user_id" is not null or "security_events"."email_hash" is not null or "security_events"."session_id" is not null or "security_events"."ip" is not null

subscriptions_canceled_check.name: subscriptions_canceled_check
subscriptions_canceled_check.value: "subscriptions"."status" <> 'canceled' or ("subscriptions"."canceled_at" is not null and "subscriptions"."ended_at" is not null)

task_approval_requests_resolution_check.name: task_approval_requests_resolution_check
task_approval_requests_resolution_check.value: ("task_approval_requests"."status" = 'pending' and "task_approval_requests"."resolved_at" is null) or ("task_approval_requests"."status" <> 'pending' and "task_approval_requests"."resolved_at" is not null)

task_approval_reviewers_decision_check.name: task_approval_reviewers_decision_check
task_approval_reviewers_decision_check.value: ("task_approval_reviewers"."status" = 'pending' and "task_approval_reviewers"."decided_at" is null) or ("task_approval_reviewers"."status" <> 'pending' and "task_approval_reviewers"."decided_at" is not null)

task_checklist_items_completion_check.name: task_checklist_items_completion_check
task_checklist_items_completion_check.value: ("task_checklist_items"."is_completed" = false and "task_checklist_items"."completed_at" is null and "task_checklist_items"."completed_by" is null) or ("task_checklist_items"."is_completed" = true and "task_checklist_items"."completed_at" is not null)

user_mfa_factors_state_check.name: user_mfa_factors_state_check
user_mfa_factors_state_check.value: ("user_mfa_factors"."status" = 'pending' and "user_mfa_factors"."enabled_at" is null) or ("user_mfa_factors"."status" = 'enabled' and "user_mfa_factors"."enabled_at" is not null)

user_sessions_revocation_check.name: user_sessions_revocation_check
user_sessions_revocation_check.value: ("user_sessions"."revoked_at" is null and "user_sessions"."revoke_reason" is null) or ("user_sessions"."revoked_at" is not null and "user_sessions"."revoke_reason" is not null)
